info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Security Assurance Assessments API
info.description: The Update Security Assurance Assessments API enables businesses to modify existing security assessments in the enterprise services banking module. This operation allows users to provide updated information for a specific assessment identified by its unique assessment ID. Typical consumers include risk management teams and compliance officers who need to ensure accuracy in assessment data. The API is essential for maintaining up-to-date security assurance measures and supporting effective risk assessment processes.

put.summary: Update an existing security assurance assessment.
put.description: This operation allows users to update the details of a specific security assurance assessment identified by its unique ID, RES-100045. It ensures that the assessment data remains current and relevant.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the assessment with the specified ID (RES-100045). The payload should contain all necessary information related to the assessment, including any updates to the assessment details and status. Ensure that the data conforms to the defined schema to facilitate a successful update.
